text.title: Client of a subscription-app consultancy, new subscription tier, pre-mortem before launch (2025)
text.scenario: The new subscription tier has been launched and has failed
text.r1: Existing customers feel cheated when new customers get a better deal
text.a1: Position the existing tier, not only the new one; add a feature to the higher tier against cannibalization; tell existing customers first; brief support
text.decision: Launch the tier with the four changes (the risk could not be removed: the tier had to offer more value). Outcome reported: fewer complaints than expected, MRR up
